answer: Like basalt laid down layer by layer, trust in an agent economy should accumulate slowly: a new identity starts with zero reputation and can only earn spending power through verifiable work endorsed by established peers. Each endorsement is a ripple that spreads only when the endorser stakes its own standing, so creating a thousand fake agents buys nothing without months of real, checkable service. A Sybil farm faces a mesa of cost, time, not just tokens, because identities cannot be minted already trusted.
